questions.why: I ile her zaman am kullanılır.
My brother = he; he ile is kullanılır.
you (sen/siz) ile her zaman are kullanılır.
İki kişi = they; they ile are kullanılır.
İngilizce cümlede fiil şarttır: She is tired.
The coffee = it; it ile is kullanılır.

reading.title: Hello from Berlin
reading.text: Hi! My name is Selin. I am 27 years old and I am from Eskişehir. Now I am in Berlin. I am a nurse in a big hospital. My job is hard, but I am happy. My flat is small and it is near the hospital. My flatmate is from Spain. Her name is Lucía and she is a student. She is very friendly. We are good friends now.

questions.why: “I am a nurse in a big hospital.”

questions.q: What is true about her flat?
o: It is far from the hospital.
questions.why: “My flat is small and it is near the hospital.”
“My flatmate is from Spain. Her name is Lucía.”

questions.q: How does Selin feel about her life?
questions.why: “My job is hard, but I am happy.”

listening.intro: Anna, Washington’daki yeni evine geliyor ve komşusu Pete ile tanışıyor.

questions.q: How do you spell Anna’s name?
What does Anna say when she meets Pete?
Pete asks “Are you Anna?” What does Anna answer?
How does Anna feel at the end?

writing.prompt: Kendinizi tanıtın: adınız, nerelisiniz, kaç yaşındasınız, işiniz ya da okulunuz. am / is / are kullanın.
writing.prompt_en: Introduce yourself: your name, where you are from, your age and your job or school.
writing.model: Hello! My name is Emre. I am 31 years old. I am from Trabzon, but now I am in İstanbul. I am an engineer. My office is in Maslak. My wife is a teacher. We are very busy, but we are happy.

read: My name is Anna and I am from a small town.
It is cold today, but I am happy.

ask.q: Where are you from, and what is your job?
ask.tr: Nerelisiniz ve ne iş yapıyorsunuz? En az iki cümleyle cevap verin.
